name: Annapurna Circuit over Thorong La
why: Round the Annapurna massif from the green rice valleys of the Marsyangdi to the dry Tibetan plateau of Mustang, over the 5,416 m Thorong La.
book: Annapurna Conservation Area permit and TIMS card (Kathmandu or Pokhara). Since April 2023 Nepal requires foreign trekkers to hire a licensed guide in its national parks and conservation areas (check the current rule before you go). Jeeps now drive much of the valley: walk the NATT side paths. Bus or jeep back from Jomsom, or fly to Pokhara.
water: Teahouses all the way; safe drinking water stations in many villages.
dangers: Thorong La at 5,416 m: sleep at Manang two nights and at Thorong Phedi or High Camp before the pass.
Leave Thorong Phedi by 05:00: wind on the pass grows in the late morning.
Snow can close the pass in any month: ask at Manang.
turnaround: If you are not on the pass by 10:00, or anyone in the group has altitude symptoms at Phedi, go back down to Manang.

points.name: Besisahar
points.note: The road head in the Marsyangdi valley; most trekkers take a jeep further up to Dharapani or Chame.

points.name: Manang
points.note: A stone village at 3,540 m under Gangapurna and its glacier lake. Rest day for the height.

points.name: Thorong La
points.note: The pass at 5,416 m, prayer flags and a tea hut in the snow.

points.name: Muktinath
points.note: A temple sacred to Hindus and Buddhists, with 108 water spouts, at the foot of the pass.

points.name: Jomsom
points.note: The windy airstrip town of the Kali Gandaki valley.
